title: Payments service returns HTTP 200 with error body instead of HTTP 400/402
root_cause: Payments service returns HTTP 200 with DECLINED status payload instead of HTTP 402/400 status code on declined payments
visible_symptoms: Orders service falsely marks failed transactions as CONFIRMED
Financial reconciliation mismatch between Gateway and Payments ledger
Prometheus shows 0% payment errors despite failing credit card charges
suggested_patch:
--- a/target-app/services/payments/app.py
+++ b/target-app/services/payments/app.py
@@ -80,5 +80,2 @@
-        return PaymentResponse(payment_id="", order_id=req.order_id, status="DECLINED", amount=req.amount, currency=req.currency)
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=402, detail="Payment declined: Transaction exceeds safety limit or card declined")
